The tournament ride on a wave of activity in the QuakeWorld scene, with a big demand for tournaments and competition. Thunderdome 15 saw 85 players from 15 countries signup, which got divided into 10 divisions. Six of which were European, three were North American and one Australian. The season officially started on the 7th of March 2021. ===Format=== * Double Elimination brackets * All matches are {{abbr|BO5|Best of Five}} * Pick, Pick, Pick, Pick * Higher seed picks first, then
